records.observation: Main resets output name then parses CLI; default output via TraceName. Opens clog2TOdrawable InputLog and OutputLog, applies positive leaf/fanout overrides, constructs trunk with shared shadow map subsequently populated by topology records. Dispatch uses Kind identity: topology creates shadow category, YCoordMap becomes LineIDMap, category stored by index, primitive resolves category (return ignored), increments count, optionally validates time and increasing latest time then adds to trunk. No composite branch. Unknown kind logs and repeats peek without consuming here. Time checks disabled by default; -tc exits on violation, -tcc logs and continues; previous end starts -Infinity and updates only in enabled branch. No reordering or explicit finite-time validation. Normal EOF flush true -> remove unused categories -> write category map -> append identity line map -> write line maps -> output close -> input close. Empty flush closes both then attempts deletion of output file, ignores delete result and exits1. Stats query input after close. No finally cleanup for earlier exit/runtime failures. CLI help exits0, unknown option exits1, last positional name wins; -nc short and -ls int overrides only applied when positive. k/K or m/M found after position0 parse prefix and multiply1024/1048576, ignore trailing text, k branch takes precedence, no overflow guard. Missing-value/number errors log then only require input nonnull, can continue with partial options. Main does not reset numeric static overrides across invocations. -o trims and only warns on suffix; no input/output equality check here. Ordinals special-case1/2/3 only. Input decoder and actual trace validity remain separate reading; archived application not executed.
